title: Philips Hue Bridge Pro: 150+ Lights, Faster & MotionAware
text:
Philips Hue Bridge Pro : Next-Gen Smart Lighting Hub Promises Speed and Expanded control Philips is poised to revolutionize the smart home lighting experience with the upcoming Hue Bridge Pro, a significantly upgraded successor to its popular central hub. The new device promises dramatically improved performance, expanded capacity, and innovative features like motion-sensing capabilities, setting a new standard for connected lighting ecosystems.
The Philips Hue Bridge has long been a cornerstone for smart lighting enthusiasts, acting as the central nervous system for Hue bulbs, switches, and other connected devices. This new iteration aims to build upon that foundation with considerable enhancements.
Did you know? – Philips Hue was one of the first widely adopted smart lighting systems, launching in 2012. The original Hue Bridge paved the way for today’s connected home lighting options. Power and Performance Boost According to reports, the Hue Bridge Pro will deliver up to five times the processing speed of the current model. This leap in performance is driven by a new quad-core Cortex processor,boasting a clock speed of 1.7 GHz and a substantial 8GB of RAM – a considerable upgrade from its predecessor.This enhanced chipset also incorporates a built-in Wi-Fi chip, supporting both wireless networks and Ethernet LAN connectivity for reliable performance.
Pro tip: – For optimal performance, consider a wired Ethernet connection for your hue Bridge Pro, especially if you have a large number of connected devices. This minimizes potential interference. Expanded Capacity for Growing Smart Homes One of the moast important improvements with the Hue Bridge Pro is its increased capacity. The device will support up to 150 lights and 50 accessories,more than tripling the current limit. This expansion caters to the growing demand for comprehensive smart home setups, allowing users to seamlessly integrate a larger number of devices into their Hue ecosystem.
Introducing MotionAware Technology Beyond raw power and capacity, the Hue Bridge Pro introduces a groundbreaking feature called “MotionAware.” This innovative technology transforms lights into motion sensors, triggering pre-set automation routines based on detected movement. This capability opens up a world of possibilities for enhanced security, convenience, and energy efficiency.
Enhanced Automation and Connectivity The increased processing power of the Hue Bridge Pro also unlocks more sophisticated automation options. The device will support up to 500 scenes and over 50 controls, giving users greater flexibility in customizing their lighting experiences. Furthermore, the Bridge Pro will maintain compatibility with major smart home platforms, including Google Home, Alexa, Samsung SmartThings, Apple HomeKit, and the Matter standard.
Modern Connectivity with USB-C A practical upgrade comes in the form of USB-C connectivity, replacing the current Hue Bridge’s power connection for enhanced compatibility and convenience.
Pricing and Availability The Philips Hue Bridge Pro is expected to launch at a price point of EUR 89.99,a step up from the current model’s EUR 59.99 retail price. US consumers can anticipate a price of around USD 100. The device is slated for release during or before the IFA tech conference in Berlin,with shipping expected to begin on September 4,2025.
